label: Push notifications to a mail: parse a poll response, build a message, plan the next poll (offline)
code:
import json
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.utils import parseaddr
from urllib.parse import urlencode

events = [
    {'id': 'a1', 'time': 1797823000, 'event': 'open', 'topic': 'demoTopic'},
    {'id': 'a2', 'time': 1797823340, 'event': 'message', 'topic': 'demoTopic', 'message': 'Hello, world!'},
    {'id': 'a3', 'time': 1797823712, 'event': 'message', 'topic': 'demoTopic',
     'title': 'Important: Read this!', 'message': 'The rent is too high!', 'priority': 5, 'tags': ['warning']},
    {'id': 'a4', 'time': 1797824000, 'event': 'keepalive', 'topic': 'demoTopic'},
]
poll_text = '\n'.join(json.dumps(e) for e in events)

notifications = [json.loads(line) for line in poll_text.splitlines()]
messages = [n for n in notifications if n['event'] == 'message']
print(len(notifications), 'lines,', len(messages), 'messages')

mail = EmailMessage()
mail['From'] = 'Notifier <notifier@example.com>'
mail['To'] = 'you@example.com'
mail['Subject'] = '%d notification(s)' % len(messages)
body = []
for n in messages:
    body.append('[%s] %s - %s' % (n.get('priority', 3), n.get('title', '(no title)'), n['message']))
mail.set_content('\n'.join(body))
print(mail['Subject'])
print(mail.get_content(), end='')
print(parseaddr(mail['From']))

last_id = messages[-1]['id']
print('next poll: /json?' + urlencode({'poll': 1, 'since': last_id}))
